unsupported.sqlite: SQLite has no users or privileges. Access to the database is access to the file.
unsupported.duckdb: DuckDB has no users or privileges. Access to the database is access to the file.
unsupported.pinecone: Pinecone has no database users. Access is controlled by the API key on the connection.
unsupported.mongodb: MongoDB manages users through its own commands rather than SQL. Not supported yet.
unsupported.snowflake: Snowflake users and roles are not supported yet.
unsupported.redshift: Redshift users and groups are not supported yet.
unsupported.db2: Db2 authorities and privileges are not supported yet.
unsupported.hana: SAP HANA users and roles are not supported yet.
unsupported.logs: A log service has no database users. Who can read these logs is set by the cloud account this connection uses, in your cloud provider.
unsupported.generic: Users and privileges are not supported for this connection yet.

dropPrincipal.user: Drop the user {who}, and everything granted to it.
dropPrincipal.role: Drop the role {who}, and everything granted to it.
dropPrincipal.login: Drop the login {who}, and everything granted to it.
dropPrincipal.group: Drop the group {who}, and everything granted to it.

emitter.badName: The {what} "{name}" contains a character that is not allowed in a name.
emitter.passwordBad: The password contains a character that is not allowed.
emitter.badPrivilege: "{privilege}" is not a valid privilege name.
emitter.policyUnsupported: {engine} {kind} objects are not supported by SnoutData yet.
emitter.badExpression: The {what} cannot contain a semicolon or a comment.
emitter.badSetting: "{name}" is not a valid setting name.

vendors.pgNoGlobal: PostgreSQL has no server-wide GRANT. Grant on a database, schema or table instead.
vendors.oracleNoSchema: Oracle has no schema-wide or database-wide GRANT. Grant the system privilege, or grant on the table.
vendors.oraclePassword: An Oracle user needs a password.
vendors.sqlserverPassword: A SQL Server login needs a password.
vendors.chNoSchema: ClickHouse has no schemas. Grant on a database or on a table instead.
vendors.chProfileEmpty: A settings profile needs at least one setting.
vendors.chQuotaWhole: A quota window has to be a whole number of units.
vendors.chQuotaUnit: "{unit}" is not a window a ClickHouse quota can be measured over.
vendors.chQuotaMetric: "{name}" is not something a ClickHouse quota can limit.
vendors.chQuotaNumber: The limit for {metric} has to be a number.
vendors.chQuotaWindow: A quota needs a window to measure over.
vendors.chRolePassword: A ClickHouse role has no password. Create a user instead, or leave the password blank.
